name: wits-world
description: Wits World project monorepo for the Wits Quest game

scripts.validate:api:build: npm run prepare:api && npm run build --workspace @wits-world/api
scripts.validate:api:coverage: npm run prepare:api && npm run test:coverage --workspace @wits-world/api
scripts.build: npm run prepare:api && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.coverage: npm run prepare:api && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present && npm run coverage:badge
scripts.test: npm run prepare:api && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.type-check: npm run prepare:api && npm run type-check --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm test && npm run build
